# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Arai eog ikajenan, Wu Ekadeke, ebe Ijo ibu kosub eog aijen Ijo kakukonokin Ijo. Etogogogit kapak kana, akalogwau ka agogong Kon, ikabakor ka amio Kon. Emamei bobo Edeke ece dimarai Ijo, Ekesigalikinan kotoma Amudiaro, elopet-Aijar.
